purpose: Four user-requested guofeng pose alternatives; review candidates, not approved designs.

records.label: A 执扇侧立
records.prompt:
INPUT ROLES: Image 1 is the exact butterfly girl whose identity to preserve while redesigning her costume into Chinese hanfu and changing her pose. Image 2 is ONLY project linework, clear shape grouping and clothing construction reference, not adult anatomy, expression, clothes or weapons to copy. Image 3 is ONLY broad matte gem-icon painting style.

Use case: stylized character costume and pose refinement for the GameXXK game.
Create one complete full-body pose image of the same gentle, cute youthful silver-haired butterfly mage. Preserve her softly rounded chibi face, lavender eyes, silver-white hair, pointed ears, paired dark-purple curved horns and purple/cyan butterfly theme. Compact project cartoon proportions approximately 3.5 actual head heights from crown to soles, EXCLUDING horns. Modest nonsexual youthful presentation, no adult body sculpting.

Costume must read unmistakably as CHINESE FANTASY HANFU: a clear ivory RIGHT-OVER-LEFT CROSS-COLLAR under a violet short ru jacket, a SMALL SIMPLE CLOUD-SHOULDER capelet with two broad cloud curves, a neat woven purple sash and ONE flat butterfly-knot/clasp, a flowing below-knee layered violet ruqun skirt with one ivory overlap panel, opaque dark-purple leggings and soft low cloth boots. No western armor, corset, exposed waist, bust contouring, high heels, complex gold harness or repeated diamond ornaments. Use very little dull gold piping, broad quiet cloth areas. The large wide WATER-SLEEVES have a clearly recognizable soft BUTTERFLY shape and lavender/cyan pattern; each sleeve is one real continuous piece of cloth attached to the arm, with rounded upper/lower wing lobes and one broad wing-eye motif. Sleeve-wing silhouette is a defining feature; no detached insect wings on the back, no duplicated sleeves. The asymmetrical drape follows the pose naturally. Silver hair half gathered by a simple small purple butterfly clasp, remaining hair in 3 broad graceful locks. Her same curved paired horns are a little smoother and more elegant, with a low simple jade-purple crown at their base, no spikes or heavy gold head armor.

Face: kind gentle lavender cartoon eyes, soft brows, little calm smile, delicate youthful charm. Simple iris colors and at most one small highlight, no sharp evil eyeliner, no sultry look.
Game gem-icon art style: confident dark-violet outside contour, sparse internal lines, 2–3 LARGE coherent matte painted color/shadow groups per material, restrained broad brush planes, large clear color shapes. No tiny polygon mosaic, clutter, overly flat thin-line anime rendering, glossy crystal material, realistic skin or eyes. Main colors silver-white / ink-violet / lavender / pale cyan, restrained ivory and dull gold.
Keep face, chest, hips and feet clearly THREE-QUARTER toward SCREEN LEFT. Each hand has believable relaxed fingers and correct connection through sleeve cuffs. Two coherent separate legs, both full feet readable. No sexualized pose.
One character only, complete horns, sleeves, hair and feet safely inside SQUARE warm-ivory plain background (#F4EFDF), about 8 percent safe margins, no inset frame, text, label, watermark, ground shadow or scenery. No collage or multiple views.

POSE A — 执扇侧立, classical graceful standing with a round silk fan:
A relaxed asymmetrical three-quarter LEFT standing pose, weight on the rear leg, forward knee slightly soft and foot just a little forward, feet remain separated. Near elbow gently bent: she holds ONE small traditional Chinese ROUND SILK FAN by its single slim handle beside the screen-left shoulder, fan face visible and not covering any of her face. Fan has one large simple pale-purple butterfly silhouette on ivory silk and a plain slim violet rim, no fine embroidery. Opposite hand loosely gathers her wide sleeve at the lower waist. Head slightly inclined toward the fan, eyes looking gently left, soft smile. Both shoulders relaxed. A delicate graceful cultured girl, not the previous hand-at-collar pose. Near butterfly sleeve forms a broad flowing droop beneath the raised forearm; far butterfly sleeve falls beside the skirt, so BOTH sleeves' butterfly motifs read clearly. All parts including the fan fully in frame. Output only this one pose.

POSE B — 拢袖浅礼, gentle Chinese greeting:
Remove the fan completely. This pose must be clearly different from holding a fan upright.
Both elbows relaxed and low. Bring BOTH HANDS TOGETHER at the upper abdomen just below the sash/chest area, one hand softly resting across the back of the other in a polite traditional sleeve-gathered greeting; small fingers can be partly visible above the joined cuffs. Forearms form a quiet shallow horizontal oval in front of her, fingers relaxed, not a fist salute and not prayer hands.
Her torso inclines very slightly forward about 8 degrees in a small polite greeting, shoulders soft, head gives a gentle small nod, kind eyes looking softly left/down and tiny warm smile. Knees softly relaxed, feet nearly side by side but a small visible gap, one heel placed half a foot-length behind so she is naturally balanced; no crossed legs or walking. Whole figure and face remain three-quarter LEFT.
The two broad butterfly sleeves drape from the joined forearms outward and down in an elegant balanced rounded butterfly arc, their big cyan/lavender motifs visible on each side. The skirt and back hair hang calmly rather than blowing sideways. This should read as a soft polite maiden greeting with folded sleeves, not a fighting stance.
Full horns/hair/both hands/both boots inside the square with clear margin, same plain warm-ivory background. No fan, extra props, butterfly particles, text or comparison layout. Keep rendering clean and matte with 2–3 large shadow masses per material.

POSE C — 提袖轻步, light graceful movement with one raised flowing sleeve:
This must have a MUCH MORE OPEN, ASYMMETRICAL SILHOUETTE than the reference standing pose or the joined-sleeves greeting.
She takes one small graceful step toward SCREEN LEFT, torso still three-quarter left and slightly inclined with the step. Front foot placed forward-left taking weight, rear foot behind with heel slightly raised and toe still touching the implied ground. Knees naturally soft, no crossed legs, no leap, no extreme ballet posture. Both full boots in frame with clear separate positions.
Her near arm lifts and extends softly outward toward upper-left at just below shoulder height, elbow relaxed in a gentle curve, wrist soft and anatomically natural, fingers loosely together, palm gently downward. This lifts the NEAR BUTTERFLY SLEEVE into one large arcing upper wing whose big lavender/cyan marking is clearly visible; it remains attached continuously from shoulder to cuff and hangs from the forearm in a soft gravity-respecting curve.
The far arm bends low beside the hip, hand lightly gathering the FAR wide sleeve to keep it from brushing the ground; its butterfly panel forms a smaller low trailing wing shape behind/right. Hands show a light natural gesture, no fan, fist, claw or pointing spell. Long skirt and broad silver hair sweep gently toward screen-right as a few large curves, suggesting a small breeze and a light step, not tangled thin ribbons.
Face has a slightly brighter warm smile, eyes softly looking forward-left. Sweet buoyant girlish grace, relaxed shoulders, no fight stance and no adult fashion/pin-up posing. Keep the same modest full torso/leg coverage and compact proportions.
Single whole figure only on uniform warm ivory, ample margin around the extended hand/sleeve and trailing hair/skirt, no text, props, butterflies or effects. Bold clean contours, simplified big hand-painted masses, no extra small detail.

POSE D — 托蝶凝望, gently gazing at a butterfly on an upturned hand:
She stands quietly in three-quarter LEFT, shoulders relaxed and slightly drawn inward. Near elbow bent so the near hand is raised just below chin height, palm turned gently UP, fingers softly curved together in a natural shallow cup, not spread as a casting claw.
ONE SMALL lavender-and-pale-cyan butterfly hovers a finger-width above that palm, at screen-left of her face. Simple four-lobed silhouette, minimal marking, no detailed insect anatomy, no particles or glow trail. This is the only extra object.
The opposite hand gently rests beneath/supports the raised forearm near its elbow, making a delicate asymmetrical folded-arm shape. Both hands physically connect naturally through their cuffs, five plausible small fingers, no duplicated hands. Her chin slightly lifted toward the butterfly, eyes clearly watching it, with a warm curious soft smile. Face stays visible rather than hidden behind hands.
Weight rests comfortably on one straight supporting leg. Other leg relaxed with knee slightly softened and foot a little back/right, a clear narrow gap between feet. Stable quiet standing, no stepping or crossed legs, no flirty hip thrust or warrior stance.
Near butterfly sleeve descends in one rounded broad arc below the upturned forearm. Far sleeve drapes lower beside the waist and skirt. Both large butterfly sleeve patterns readable, but the hand/butterfly near her face is the pose's focal point. The long silver hair falls in broad relaxed locks behind her shoulder, gentle asymmetry, no wind explosion.
The silhouette should be clearly different from the open extended-arm step, the joined-hands greeting and fan-holding pose. Preserve all costume details and compact proportions from reference without increasing ornament density. Entire horn tips, little hovering butterfly, both sleeves and both feet safely inside square plain warm-ivory canvas with clear margins. No fan, other butterflies, effects, text, frames or background scene.
